subject: Handoff: AwayPoint pilot — implementation owners & PoC timeline
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AwayPoint pilot — signed, quick summary & asks

Team — good news, AwayPoint signed the 12-month pilot (see SOW attached). Quick deal snapshot: pilot scope = embeddings + low-latency text gen for search assistant; expected monthly token volume ~ 25M; committed monthly spend for Dedicated burst capacity during PoC window. Key acceptance criteria in SOW: MRR latency <= 400ms p95, embedding vector recall >= 88% on our eval set, and a security review completion with SOC2 evidence.

Immediate asks for handoff: 
- CS owner: point person for kickoff/week-of ops + day-to-day cadence (we should name someone).
- Implementation lead: technical owner for model selection, test dataset ingestion, and infra connectivity (VPC whitelisting).
- Pre-kickoff deliverables from Sales (attached): signed SOW, initial kickoff agenda, expected first-run test dataset, procurement POC contact.

Timing: AwayPoint is targeting a pilot kickoff the week of Dec 13 (they've asked for Wed/Thu). Procurement signing/PO expected the week of Dec 13 as well.

Notes / risks: 
- They requested a dedicated subnet and KMS integration — engineering will need a contact for network/keys.
- They may request a short SLA for the pilot window; we should clarify fallback model variants if the Dedicated capacity is constrained.

Attached: AwayPoint_SOW_v1.pdf (sales-signed) and AwayPoint_Service_Addendum.xlsx

Ben
